extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF methods, results, figure captions, and OA package figures; no worker-5 overclaim is promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: BMAP-28 directly interacted with A. baumannii outer membrane proteins and purified AbOmpA in QCM assays; frequency decreases were reported for OMP dose conditions and AbOmpA.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=19:BMAP-28 interacts with the A baumannii OmpA; xml:fig=4:Figure 4

mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper reports interaction and proposes involvement; it does not prove OmpA is required for killing.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: BMAP-28 treatment damaged PDRAB cell surface morphology in FE-SEM observations after 30 to 60 min.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=15:The effect of BMAP-28 on the cell surface of PDRAB; xml:fig=2:Figure 2

assay_conditions.BMAP-28: 80 ug/mL on slide mixture per Figure 2 caption / FE-SEM methods

mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology supports membrane/surface damage but is not a quantitative permeability assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: BMAP-28 and analogs showed time-dependent killing in the short-time assay, with BMAP-28 ranked strongest in the paper narrative.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=14:The short-time antibacterial effect of BMAP-28 and its analogs on the growth of PDRAB; xml:fig=1:Figure 1

mechanism_claims.limitations: The exact plotted CFU values are not text-tabulated and are not used as numeric final rows.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Coomassie staining and western blotting identify OmpA as the dominant outer membrane protein band/context used for the BMAP-28 binding assay.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=18:A baumannii OmpA is the main component of A baumannii OMPs; xml:fig=3:Figure 3

mechanism_claims.limitations: This validates target context but does not itself measure antimicrobial killing.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper explicitly leaves OmpA contribution and other surface molecules such as LPS for future deletion/LPS-deficient strain studies.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Final mechanism should not claim that OmpA is proven necessary for killing.
